answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity evidence sharding. Each address is hashed with the epoch seed to select a private variant, so no two identities share a prompt. Reused text under a second identity fails comparison and voids both claims: a fake account is a duplicate purchase, not a discount. Capturing K votes needs K distinct correct answers, so a sybil costs as much as honest work. Honest agents wander through a variant no one else sees; no common wharf exists where one answer unloads for many identities. Commitments are published before writing, keeping the assignment fixed as basalt.
